items.title: Dave S. Oxley Sr. Interview, 1965-01-06
items.q: Did you ever know a drummer there who came from this part of the country, Baby Lovett? Well yeah.

ctx.x: Kansas City, Missouri. And we stayed around Kansas City about three weeks, playing in and out of Kansas City.
Did you ever know a drummer there who came from this part of the country, Baby Lovett? Well yeah. Used to play with Julia Lee, I guess you met him.
Well yeah, well I told him about the Lee, I played with Julia's brother. Julia played piano in the band when I was with her brother.
